why: A2.2 G-B. `: base(s, keep)` is a call that hands the owned parameter to the base constructor before the body runs; A2.1 does not record constructor initializers.
a2_contract: A2.2 records the initializer as a calls[] entry: callee = `GuardedBase..ctor`, site = the initializer, statement_line = its line, form = statement (it runs as a statement and its result is discarded), args param 0 -> param{0}, param 1 -> param{1}.
